id.description: Id of the MLS (multiple listing service) listing; each record in this file is one MLS listing.

residentialListingId.description: Id of one attempt to sell or rent one home, shared by every MLS listing of that home and attempt. Several records can have the same value.

propertyId.description: Id of the home itself: a house, or one condo or apartment unit.

transactionType.description: Whether the listing is for sale or for rent. Filter on this before comparing prices, because rentals carry monthly rent.

listingStatus.description: MLS status of the listing: active, contract (under contract), sold (which also covers a leased rental), inactive or removed.

forSaleStatus.description: Homes.com for-sale status of the listing, such as for sale, under contract, sold or recently off market. Null on rentals.

forRentStatus.description: Homes.com for-rent status of the listing, such as for rent or rented. Filled only on rentals.

listDate.description: Date the listing was put on the market, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

offMarketDate.description: Date the listing went off the market, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

contractDate.description: Date the home went under contract, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

closeDate.description: Closing date of the sale, or the lease date for a rental, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Filled mainly on sold listings.

availabilityDate.description: Date a rental or new home becomes available, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Filled on few listings.

certifiedDate.description: Date a new-home listing was last certified or updated by the builder, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Filled on few listings.

closePrice.description: Final price at closing in US dollars: the sale price for a sale, or the agreed monthly rent for a rental. Null on Texas sold or recently-off-market for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

currentPrice.description: Current asking price in US dollars: the list price for a sale or the monthly rent for a rental. On a sold listing it is the last asking price before the sale. Null on Texas sold or recently-off-market for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

listPriceMax.description: Highest list price in US dollars across a new-home floor plan's listings. Filled on few listings.

listPriceMin.description: Lowest list price in US dollars across a new-home floor plan's listings. Filled on few listings.

rentMax.description: Highest monthly rent in US dollars for the rental listing. Filled on rentals only.

rentMin.description: Lowest monthly rent in US dollars for the rental listing. Filled on rentals only.

listingType.description: Kind of sale, such as resale, new home, short sale or foreclosure. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

dom.description: Days on market: the number of days the listing has been on the market.

domDate.description: Date on which `dom` was last counted, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

virtualDateOnMarket.description: Date on market adjusted to account for time the home spent off the market, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

monetaryUnit.description: Currency of the prices on the listing; every listing in this kit uses US dollars.

originalPrice.description: Asking price when the listing was first put on the market, in US dollars (monthly rent for a rental). Null on Texas sold or recently-off-market for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

removedDate.description: Date the listing was removed from Homes.com, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Filled on few listings.

remarks.description: The agent's public marketing description of the home, as free text.

sourceNumber.description: The MLS number of the listing, the number agents use to find it in their MLS.

altSourceNumber.description: A second MLS number for the listing, when the MLS uses one. Filled on few listings.

specialFeatures.description: Marketing flags on the listing, such as new home, price reduction or virtual tour. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

resoValues.description: Standardized listing features (RESO, the real estate data standard) such as heating, cooling, pool, HOA fees and parking.

property.description: The home the listing is for: its address, type, size, beds and baths, and the other listings of the same home.

media.description: Photos, 3D tours, videos and floor plans of the listing.

agents.description: The agents on the listing, such as the listing agent, with their contact and brokerage details.

openHouses.description: Open houses scheduled for the listing. Filled on few listings.

permissionLevels.description: Access levels that control who may see parts of the listing on Homes.com.

newHomesInfo.description: Extra details for new-construction listings, such as the community, builder and floor plan. Filled on few listings.

offices.description: The MLS offices (brokerages) on the listing, with their contact details.

source.description: Where the listing information came from: the MLS listing id and kind of data.

history.description: Events in the life of the listing, such as new, price change, under contract and sold.

isPrimaryForThisListingInstance.description: Whether this is the primary MLS listing among those of the same sale or rent attempt.

attributionContact.description: Contact for crediting the listing under IDX rules, such as a phone number or email. Filled on few listings.

displayPrice.description: Price information Homes.com shows to the public for a sold or recently off-market home: recent sale values and the latest automated value estimate.

has3DTour.description: Whether the listing has a 3D tour.

hasOtherRecentlySoldOrOffMarketListings.description: Whether the home has other recently sold or off-market listings.

hasVideo.description: Whether the listing has a video.

costarFeatureValues.description: Home features detected by CoStar from photos and listing text, as a counterpart to resoValues.

isInCondoBuilding.description: Whether the home is part of a condo building.

mls.description: The MLS (multiple listing service) that supplied the listing and its display rules.

architecturalStyleType.description: Architectural style of the home, such as traditional or contemporary. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

coolingType.description: Cooling systems the home has, such as central air. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

hasBasement.description: Whether the home has a basement.

hasGarage.description: Whether the home has a garage.

hasFireplace.description: Whether the home has a fireplace.

hasHardwoodFloors.description: Whether the home has hardwood floors.

hasInLawSuite.description: Whether the home has an in-law suite.

hasSpa.description: Whether the home has a spa or hot tub.

hasDishwasher.description: Whether the home has a dishwasher.

hasElevator.description: Whether the building has an elevator.

hasGym.description: Whether the home or building has a gym.

hasGolfCourse.description: Whether the home is on or next to a golf course.

hasAccessibilityFeatures.description: Whether the home has accessibility features.

hasStorage.description: Whether the home has extra storage space.

hasWasherDryer.description: Whether the home has a washer and dryer.

heatingType.description: Heating systems the home has, such as forced air or electric. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

hoa.description: Homeowners association (HOA) details for the home.

isWaterfront.description: Whether the home is on the waterfront.

isNearPublicTransportation.description: Whether the home is near public transportation.

lotType.description: Features of the lot, such as corner lot or cul-de-sac. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

listingDatesPriceChangeTimestamp.description: Date and time of the latest price change, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

listingStandardStatus.description: Numeric code for the RESO standard listing status, such as active, pending or closed; the codes are not decoded in this kit.

listingContractSpecialListingConditions.description: Numeric code for special conditions of the listing contract, such as short sale or auction; the codes are not decoded in this kit.

listPrice.description: List price in US dollars (monthly rent for a rental). Null on Texas sold or recently-off-market for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

originalListPrice.description: First list price in US dollars (monthly rent for a rental). Null on Texas sold or recently-off-market for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

outdoorSpaceType.description: Outdoor spaces the home has, such as patio, balcony or yard. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

previousListPrice.description: List price before the latest change, in US dollars. Null on Texas sold or recently-off-market for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

poolType.description: Kind of pool the home has, such as private or community. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

propertyConditionType.description: Condition of the property, such as new construction or needs repair.

roomType.description: Special rooms the home has, such as a den, office or game room. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

securityFeatureType.description: Security features the home has, such as gated entry or alarm system. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

structure.description: Building details such as stories, year built, parking and fireplaces.

totalLandLeaseFeesPerMonth.description: Monthly land lease fee in US dollars, for homes on leased land. Filled on few listings.

viewType.description: Views the home has, such as city, water or mountain. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

washerDryerType.description: Washer and dryer arrangement, such as in-unit, hookups only or shared. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

hasAssociation.description: Whether the home belongs to a homeowners association.

totalFeesPerMonth.description: Total HOA fees per month in US dollars.

fee.description: The HOA fee in US dollars, charged at the frequency given by feeFrequency.

feeFrequency.description: Numeric code for how often the HOA fee is charged, such as monthly or annually; the codes are not decoded in this kit.

fee2.description: A second HOA fee in US dollars, charged at the frequency given by fee2Frequency. Filled on few listings.

fee2Frequency.description: Numeric code for how often the second HOA fee is charged; the codes are not decoded in this kit. Filled on few listings.

associationName.description: Name of the homeowners association or its management company.

associationPhone.description: Phone number of the homeowners association.

hasNewConstruction.description: Whether the home is new construction.

hasFireplace.description: Whether the home has a fireplace.

fireplacesTotal.description: Number of fireplaces in the home.

stories.description: Number of stories (floors) of the home or unit.

storiesTotal.description: Total number of stories of the building.

hasCarport.description: Whether the home has a carport.

carportSpaces.description: Number of carport parking spaces. Filled on few listings.

coveredSpaces.description: Number of covered parking spaces. Filled on few listings.

openParkingSpaces.description: Number of open parking spaces. Filled on few listings.

hasBasement.description: Whether the home has a basement.

architecturalStyle.description: Architectural style of the home as free text, such as Traditional or Contemporary.

address.description: Location of the home: street address, city, ZIP, coordinates and the areas it falls in.

propertyType.description: Type of home, such as detached house, townhouse or condo.

listingPropertyType.description: Type of home as given on the listing, such as detached house, townhouse or condo.

propertyTypeSource.description: Where the property type came from, such as the listing, public records or CoStar features.

mlsPropertyType.description: Property type text as the MLS reports it, such as Residential, Detached.

bathsMin.description: Lowest number of bathrooms; a half bath counts as 0.5. Equal to bathsMax for a single home.

bathsMax.description: Highest number of bathrooms; a half bath counts as 0.5.

bedsMin.description: Lowest number of bedrooms. Equal to bedsMax for a single home.

garageSpacesMax.description: Highest number of garage spaces. Filled on few listings.

garageSpacesMin.description: Lowest number of garage spaces. Filled on few listings.

lotSizeAcresMin.description: Lot size in acres. Equal to lotSizeAcresMax for a single home.

lotSizeSource.description: Where the lot size came from, such as the listing or public records.

model.description: Builder's floor plan name for a new home. Filled on few listings.

ownership.description: Kind of ownership, such as Full Ownership or Fractional Ownership.

sqftMin.description: Living area in square feet. Equal to sqftMax for a single home.

sqftMax.description: Largest living area in square feet.

sqftSource.description: Where the square footage came from, such as the listing or public records.

stories.description: Number of stories of the home.

subdivision.description: Name of the subdivision the home is in.

taxes.description: Annual property tax in US dollars, as reported by the MLS.

unitsCount.description: Number of units in the building, for condos and multi-unit homes.

url.description: Path of the home's page on Homes.com, made of state, city and street. Null on the 4 listings whose address is hidden from the public.

yearBuiltSource.description: Where the year built came from, such as the listing or public records.

listings.description: The MLS listings of the same home, usually including this one, with their status, dates and prices.

id.description: Id of the residential property (the parcel or building) that contains the home. A condo building has one property and many homes.

buildingName.description: Name of the building, for condos and apartments. Filled on few listings.

countryCode.description: Three-letter country code; USA on every listing.

streetNumber.description: House or building number. Null on the 4 listings whose address is hidden from the public.

streetName.description: Street name without number, direction or type. Null on the 4 listings whose address is hidden from the public.

streetDirPrefix.description: Direction before the street name, such as N or W. Filled on few listings.

streetDirSuffix.description: Direction after the street name, such as N or S. Filled on few listings.

streetSuffix.description: Street type, such as St, Ave or Dr.

fullStreetAddress.description: Full street address on one line. Null on the 4 listings whose address is hidden from the public.

floorNumber.description: Floor the unit is on, for condos and apartments. Filled on few listings.

unitNumber.description: Unit or apartment number, for condos, townhomes and apartments.

latitude.description: Latitude of the home in decimal degrees. Null on the 4 listings whose address is hidden from the public.

longitude.description: Longitude of the home in decimal degrees. Null on the 4 listings whose address is hidden from the public.

modelName.description: Builder's floor plan name for a new home, such as Plan 1925. Filled on few listings.

state.description: Two-letter US state of the home: TX for Houston or CA for Los Angeles.

areas.description: List of geographic areas the home falls in, such as state, county, city, neighborhood and school district.

cityMetadata.description: Display information about the city of the home.

communityId.description: Id of the new-home community the address belongs to. Filled on few listings.

enterpriseEntityType.description: Kind of area, such as state, county, city or neighborhood.

enterpriseEntitySubType.description: More specific kind of the area when there is one.

enterpriseEntityId.description: Id of the area, to be read together with its type.

name.description: Name of the area, such as Texas or Houston.

isPreferred.description: Whether this is the preferred area of its kind for the home.

associatedCityId.description: Id of the city the area is associated with.

neighborhoodId.description: Id of the neighborhood, when the area is a neighborhood.

isCommunityProjectSchool.description: Whether the area is marked as a community project school. Filled on few listings.

naturalFeatureType.description: Kind of natural feature the area is, such as a park or water body; 0 means none.

neighborhoodType.description: Kind of neighborhood the area is.

cityDisplayName.description: City name as Homes.com displays it.

id.description: Id of that MLS listing; the entry for this record has the record's own `id`.

listingInstanceId.description: Id of the sale or rent attempt the listing belongs to; matches residentialListingId.

listingStatus.description: MLS status of that listing, such as active, under contract or sold.

transactionType.description: Whether that listing is for sale or for rent.

closeDate.description: Closing date of that listing, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

listDate.description: List date of that listing, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

mlsId.description: Id of the MLS that supplied that listing.

permissionLevels.description: Access levels that control who may see parts of that listing on Homes.com.

forSaleListingStatus.description: Homes.com for-sale status of that listing. Null on rentals.

forRentListingStatus.description: Homes.com for-rent status of that listing. Filled only on rentals.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary listing of the home.

isPrimaryForThisListingInstance.description: Whether this is the primary listing of its sale or rent attempt.

closePrice.description: Closing price of that listing in US dollars. Null on Texas sale listings that are sold or recently off market, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

currentPrice.description: Current asking price of that listing in US dollars (monthly rent for a rental). Null on Texas sale listings that are sold or recently off market, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

originalPrice.description: First asking price of that listing in US dollars (monthly rent for a rental). Null on Texas sale listings that are sold or recently off market, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

homes.description: Minimum Homes.com user level allowed to see the listing on Homes.com of that listing; 10 is public and higher values are restricted.

description.description: Description of the media item, such as the room shown. MLS media only.

displayOrder.description: Position of the item in the MLS photo order. MLS media only.

type.description: Kind of media item, such as photo, 3D tour, floor plan or map.

uri.description: Link to the media item: a photo or map at homes.com, a Matterport tour at my.matterport.com, or a video or tour on another site. Photo links use image size 112; replace the /112/ path segment for another size. Map links are 1800x1200. Matterport links use the ids of the copies made for this kit, the same ids as in residential-listings.csv.

videoKey.description: Key that identifies a video or 3D tour, for example the id after m= in a Matterport tour link.

height.description: Height of the image in pixels.

width.description: Width of the image in pixels.

fileExtension.description: File extension of the item, such as Jpg. Filled on few listings.

entityId.description: Id of the listing, unit or floor plan the item belongs to. Filled on few listings.

threeDimensionalScanType.description: Vendor of the 3D tour, such as Matterport. Filled on 3D tour items.

videoType.description: Hosting service of the video, such as YouTube or Vimeo.

source.description: Who supplied the media item: the MLS, CoStar or a builder.

thumbnailUri.description: Link to a small preview image of the item. Replace the /112/ segment of the path to get another image size (114 is 1024x1024, 210 is 2560x1440, 102 is 984x658).

externalReferenceType.description: Numeric code for the outside system that supplied the item; mostly useful to tell CoStar scans from MLS items.

scenes.description: Labels from automatic image analysis of the photo, such as the kind of room or amenity shown.

altText.description: Alternative text describing the image, generated automatically.

computerVisionKeywords.description: Names of the home features detected in the image by automatic image analysis, such as Hardwood Floor.

imageId.description: Id of the image the scene label belongs to.

type.description: Kind of room or amenity detected in the image, such as kitchen, balcony or swimming pool.

id.description: Id of the agent in the MLS.

userId.description: Id of the agent's Homes.com user account.

companyName.description: Name of the brokerage company the agent works for.

email.description: Agent's email address, as shown publicly on Homes.com.

bio.description: Agent's biography, as shown publicly on Homes.com.

role.description: Role of the agent on the listing, such as listing agent or selling agent. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

mlsId.description: Id of the MLS the agent belongs to.

mlsOfficeId.description: Id of the MLS office the agent works from; matches an id in offices.

isActive.description: Whether the MLS agent record is active.

profileImage.description: Link to the agent's profile photo. Replace the /112/ segment of the path to get another size.

website.description: Agent's website. Filled on few listings.

phoneNumber.description: Agent's phone number, as shown publicly on Homes.com.

phoneType.description: Kind of the agent's phone number, such as mobile or office.

licenseState.description: US state of the agent's license.

brokerageName.description: Name of the brokerage brand, such as RE/MAX. Filled on few listings.

brokerageId.description: Id of the brokerage brand. Filled on few listings.

officePhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the agent's office.

officeEmailAddress.description: Email address of the agent's office.

locationId.description: Id of the brokerage location the agent is attached to.

openHouseDate.description: Date of the open house, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

openHouseBegins.description: Start of the open house in the home's local time, written as an ISO 8601 date-time.

openHouseBeginsUtc.description: Start of the open house in UTC, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

openHouseClose.description: End of the open house in the home's local time, written as an ISO 8601 date-time.

openHouseCloseUtc.description: End of the open house in UTC, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

remarks.description: Agent's remarks about the open house, as free text.

refreshments.description: Refreshments offered at the open house, as free text.

timeZoneId.description: Id of the time zone of the local start and end times.

listingId.description: Id of the new-home listing as Homes.com search uses it.

newHomesType.description: Kind of new-home listing, such as floor plan or move-in ready home.

community.description: The new-home community the listing belongs to.

communityProject.description: The new-home project (a group of homes being built together) the listing belongs to.

floorPlan.description: The builder's floor plan of the home. Filled on few listings.

moveInReady.description: Details for a move-in ready new home. Filled on few listings.

primaryNeigborhoodId.description: Id of the neighborhood the community is mainly in.

description.description: Description of the developer, as free text.

logoUrl.description: Link to the developer's logo. Replace the /112/ segment of the path to get another size.

countryCode.description: Three-letter country code of the developer's address.

streetNumber.description: Street number of the developer's address.

streetName.description: Street name of the developer's address.

latitude.description: Latitude of the developer's address in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the developer's address in decimal degrees.

state.description: Two-letter US state of the developer's address.

listingId.description: Id of the project's listing as Homes.com search uses it.

description.description: Description of the builder, as free text.

logoUrl.description: Link to the builder's logo. Replace the /112/ segment of the path to get another size.

url.description: Link to the floor plan on the builder's website.

floorPlanName.description: Name of the floor plan the move-in ready home is built from.

mlsFloorPlanListingId.description: Id of the MLS listing of that floor plan.

id.description: Id of the MLS office; matches agents.mlsOfficeId.

brokerageID.description: Id of the brokerage brand. Filled on few listings.

countryCode.description: Three-letter country code of the office.

isActive.description: Whether the MLS office record is active.

latitude.description: Latitude of the office in decimal degrees. Filled on few listings.

longitude.description: Longitude of the office in decimal degrees. Filled on few listings.

role.description: Numeric code for the office's role on the listing, such as listing office; the codes are not decoded in this kit.

status.description: Numeric status code of the office; the codes are not decoded in this kit.

state.description: State of the office, as an abbreviation or full name.

website.description: Website of the office. Filled on few listings.

sourceType.description: Kind of data the listing comes from, such as MLS or new homes.

date.description: Date of the event, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

currentPrice.description: Asking price in US dollars at the time of the event (monthly rent for a rental). Null on the sold event of Texas for-sale listings, because Texas does not disclose sale prices.

modificationTimestamp.description: When the event was recorded, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

newValue.description: Value after the change, as a number; for status changes it is a status code.

newValueString.description: Value after the change, as text.

oldValue.description: Value before the change, as a number; for status changes it is a status code.

oldValueString.description: Value before the change, as text.

status.description: Extra flags on the event, such as being a secondary event or a return to market. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

updateType.description: What kind of change the event records, such as newly active, price change, under contract, sold or removed.

residentialPropertyId.description: Id of the residential property that contains the home; matches property.address.id.

latitude.description: Latitude of the home in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the home in decimal degrees.

values.description: List of price values for the home, such as the recent sale or an automated estimate. Has no estimate entries where the MLS forbids showing an estimate.

isNonDisclosureState.description: Whether the home is in a non-disclosure state such as Texas, where sale prices are not public.

latestAVM.description: The latest automated value estimate (AVM) of the home with its low and high range. Null where the MLS forbids showing an estimate.

valueType.description: What the value is, such as an automated estimate or a recent sale price. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

listingId.description: Id of the MLS listing the value comes from, when it is a recent sale.

year.description: Year of the estimate. Filled on few listings.

month.description: Month of the estimate, 1 to 12. Filled on few listings.

high.description: High end of the estimate range, in US dollars.

low.description: Low end of the estimate range, in US dollars.

current.description: The estimated value in US dollars.

coolingType.description: Kind of cooling detected, such as central air. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

hasInLawSuite.description: Whether an in-law suite was detected.

heatingType.description: Kind of heating detected, such as forced air. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

poolType.description: Kind of pool detected, such as private or community. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.

viewType.description: Kind of view detected, such as city or water. Bit flags: a value can combine several codes.
